Charcoal on one side of that hairline, cream on the other, and cream everywhere else. Each lobe carries its own separate tangle of soft violet-lavender thread — the synthetic circular chromosome — drawn in wide open wandering loops that drift apart like a dropped ball of yarn coming undone, filling about half of its lobe. Around and between the loops, dozens of small teal dots, all the same small size, evenly and densely speckled across the cream right out to the hairline. The cream holds nothing else.
